items.title: David Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2022
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe introducing himself and the interviewee. There is no dialogue or narrative indicating a personal or professional relationship between David Weiss and Monk Rowe beyond the interviewer-interviewee dynamic.

ctx.x: David was interviewed via Zoom on February 3, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have David Weiss with me today who is a composer, arranger, band leader, and, according to Jazz Times has righteous trumpet chops.
